description: CESAR-P (Combined Energy Simulation and Retrofit in Python) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Urban Energy Systems Lab, Empa (Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology). The package allows for simulating the building energy demand of a district, including options for retrofitting, cost and emission calculation. Coverage: Switzerland. The fact sheet classes it as: Swiss building stock. Sectors: electricity, heating, cooling, domestic hot water. Resolution: time Hour, geography depending on input data. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is AGPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
